title: NUMPYBOOK-COMPLETE-MATHEMATICAL-AND-C-API-COMPENDIUM
universal_lens: MSE-optimal biased covariance estimation via James-Stein shrinkage principle for small-sample variance regularization. Kaiser windowing and Bessel functions enable optimal FIR filtering for temporal trend smoothing, bridging spectral concentration and signal fidelity.
gsi_mapping: Bayesian inference with Stein-shrunk covariance priors enables robust tactical variance modeling in sparse game data windows. GSI employs biased covariance and Kaiser windows to refine coaching trajectory inference, reducing noise from short-term volatility.
gse_mapping: Situational reasoning engine applies biased covariance with ddof=0 to stabilize Cholesky whitening during coach tendency inference on short-term rollouts. GSE uses directional statistics and von Mises distributions to model angular motion in player movement and environmental forces.
